items.title: Snowman Waving a Red Mitten
items.alt: Smiling snowman waving a red knitted mitten, wearing a teal cap and chevron scarf with three wooden buttons.
items.description: A raised mitten, tilted pom-pom cap and curved twig arm give this round snowman a friendly greeting pose.

items.title: Snowman Feeding a Cardinal
items.alt: Tall snowman in a green earflap hat holding a wooden seed tray with a red cardinal perched on its edge.
items.description: The snowman looks toward the small red bird while holding a seed-filled tray with both branch arms.

items.title: Snowman Riding a Red Sled
items.alt: Laughing snowman in a purple pom-pom hat and cream scarf seated on a red sled with both twig arms raised.
items.description: Rounded snow feet rest on the sled while the character leans back with an open smile and lifted arms.

items.title: Snowman Posting a Letter
items.alt: Snowman in a red wool cap and scarf placing an envelope in a blue mailbox, with a brown satchel at its side.
items.description: A branch hand reaches into the open mailbox as the other arm rests beside the shoulder bag.

items.title: Snowman Gliding on Ice Skates
items.alt: Slender snowman in a green beanie and orange striped scarf balancing on one skate with the other leg raised behind.
items.description: Outstretched twig arms and a trailing scarf emphasize the sweeping skating pose.

items.title: Snowman Reading a Blue Book
items.alt: Seated snowman with round spectacles and a burgundy beret holding an open blue book above a red heart button.
items.description: The round-eyed reader sits with two snow feet forward and both branch hands holding the book covers.
